function: Excluded (function): the learned transformer-based tracking function estimates UE positions from multi-band CSI, i.e. positioning and tracking (p. 5, Eqs. 8-9), not beams, waveforms or resources.
notes: Excluded, reason function. The X2Track learned function maps multi-band CSI sequences to UE positions and is trained to minimize the axial tracking error (p. 5: "estimates the track of UE"; Eq. 9 is the mean absolute position error), which is positioning/tracking, an excluded function. It designs no beams, waveforms or resources, and the RIS configuration is not optimized (p. 4: "no optimization of the RISs"), so area 5 (ISAC) does not apply. Learning is present (transformer with adversarial domain adaptation, p. 8-9), so no_learning does not apply. Title and DOI checked on p. 1.
